title.en: The Job Monitor That Lied for 27 Days
title.zh: 那個騙了我 27 天的求職監控系統

desc.en: An AI-built daily job-search monitor that ran green on GitHub Actions for nearly a month while quietly catching nothing — and the three-act bug hunt that found out why.
desc.zh: 一個用 AI 打造的每日求職監控系統，在 GitHub Actions 上連續綠燈跑了將近一個月卻什麼都沒抓到——以及找出真相的三幕除錯偵探故事。

desc.zh: 一款我沒寫一行程式碼、為農曆新年做的三關手機遊戲，以及它教會我的事：怎麼把「感覺不對」變成 AI 修得了的回饋。

title.zh: 這個作品集是怎麼寫出來的

subtitle.zh: 一個 meta 的案例研究

desc.en: AI drafts, I own the judgment: the same quality system I built for AI-written quiz questions, applied to writing this site, and the lesson the AI wrote that wasn't mine.
desc.zh: AI 起草，判斷由我負責：把我替答題 App 建立的品質系統用在寫這個網站上，以及 AI 替我寫出、但不屬於我的那個教訓。

about.en:
I've spent 8+ years in product and growth on consumer apps, leading international expansion across Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. At a community platform, I led the product repositioning for the Japan market, which improved long-term retention by 300%, and built the moderator and creator ecosystem from zero to one — growing posts by 36% and engagement time by 30% through a mix of product and ops incentives.

I also led analytics instrumentation for ML-driven recommendation and search at 20M+ MAU: defining the events and schemas, and working with data engineers and data scientists to validate data quality before it fed experiments and model iterations.

The projects here are where I bring the same habits to building with AI. Nihongo Quiz King's word bank gets the treatment I'd give a data pipeline: a written spec, automated checks, and reviewers that are calibrated before anyone trusts them. The job monitor taught me, again, that a green dashboard isn't a healthy system. Each article is about one judgment call you can take into your own work.
about.zh:
我在消費型 App 做了 8 年以上的產品與成長，負責過日本、台灣、香港和東南亞的海外擴張。在一個社群平台，我主導日本市場的產品重新定位，讓長期留存提升 300%；也從零建立版主與創作者生態，用產品加營運誘因，讓發文數成長 36%、使用時間成長 30%。

我也主導過月活 2,000 萬以上規模的推薦與搜尋埋點：定義事件和資料結構，並和資料工程師、資料科學家一起驗證資料品質，再拿這些資料做實驗和模型迭代。

這裡的專案，是我把同樣的習慣帶進 AI 開發的地方。日文知識王的題庫，我用對待資料管線的方式對待它：先寫規格、再做自動檢查，AI 評審也要先校準過才能信任。求職監控則再一次提醒我：儀表板全綠，不代表系統健康。每篇文章都在講一個判斷，你可以帶回自己的工作裡用。

title.en: Building things that matter with AI
title.zh: 用 AI 打造 真正有意義的產品

subtitle.en: I'm Tim — a product and growth leader with 8+ years building consumer apps across Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. Here, I build and ship my own products with AI, and write up the judgment calls behind them — including the ones I got wrong.
subtitle.zh: 我是 Tim，在消費型 App 做了 8 年以上的產品與成長，負責過日本、台灣、香港和東南亞市場。在這裡，我用 AI 打造並上線自己的產品，也把背後的判斷寫下來，包括我做錯的那些。

title.en: From Zero to an App People Use: Five Decisions

desc.en: Hiding the kanji, a rival without a server, simple designs and the assumptions behind them, App Store review, and giving the AI a memory
desc.zh: 把漢字藏起來、不需要伺服器的對手、簡單設計背後的假設、App Store 審查，以及給 AI 一份記憶

title.en: Test the Reviewer Before You Trust It

desc.en: The first AI reviewer caught half the known problems. How I built a five-layer evaluation system for 640 AI-written questions, and what still got through.
desc.zh: 第一版 AI 評審只抓到一半的已知問題。我怎麼替 640 道 AI 產出的題目建立五層評測，以及還是漏掉了什麼。

desc.en: Adding kana mode and a 314-word N5 level: an evening of checking became a few minutes, and organic downloads doubled
desc.zh: 加入假名模式和 314 字的 N5：原本一個晚上的檢查變成幾分鐘，自然下載翻倍

title.en: It Wasn't the AI. It Was the Clock.

desc.en: New players kept losing. I made the AI easier; the data said they were answering too slowly. Plus the daily loop built for retention. Work in progress.
desc.zh: 新玩家一直輸，我讓 AI 變簡單；數據說問題是他們答得太慢。以及為了留存做的每日循環。持續更新中。
